notes.title: Drawy v2.5 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Drawy!

We are thrilled to see that our community on Twitch has grown to over [b]10K followers[/b] and we couldn't have done it without your support.

We value your feedback and have listened to your suggestions so far. This update includes new features and improvements that we hope will enhance your gaming experience and make Drawy even more fun to play.

[b]New Word Selection Algorithm[/b]
- Enjoy the new words and say goodbye to repetitions with the new word selection algorithm.

[b]Word Packs[/b]
- Playing with your own words is a lot easier now with the word packs. You can create multiple word packs and play the way you like.

[b]Drawing Shortcuts[/b]
- Keyboard shortcuts are added so that you can conveniently switch between drawing tools.

We are also working on a [b]major multiplayer update[/b] that will introduce a fun new way to play and make the game [b]competetive across streamers[/b]. We can't wait to share it with you soon.

As always, feel free to give us any feedback on our Steam community page. Also, don't forget to check out our other Twitch games! We have recently released a new party game called [b]Parlor [/b]where you give verbal or physical clues to your viewers and they try to guess the word.

notes.title: CUSTOM WORDS UPDATE
notes.content: You can now create your own themes to play with your own words.
